invariants: This is a bounded repair of TP-DMX-DELTA-REHARVEST-001 on existing PR #1205; do not restart the portfolio investigation from scratch.
The previously harvested PR metadata and complete changed-file evidence may be reused when its bound PR head is unchanged.
At execution start, refresh origin/main and PR #1205 head. The previously observed head d6c07835f1fc988f2f0b111e4224113d4e789388 is context, not an exact-SHA stop gate.
Ordinary movement of main or an open PR is not a blanket stop. Refresh only affected facts and relationships.
Never classify two PRs as independent merely because their changed-file sets are disjoint.
Pair evidence must separate path relationship, Git ancestry, base-ref relationship, tree relationship, patch relationship, and merge-tree result rather than collapsing them into one heuristic label.
A non-main baseRefName matching another open PR headRefName must be represented as an explicit stack relationship even if that predecessor branch has moved since the successor branch was created.

PR #1183 must mechanically resolve its baseRefName claude/rte-truth-program to open PR #1136 when that live relationship still exists. If current-head ancestry no longer matches, classify that drift explicitly rather than forcing a false ancestry claim.

Changed-file reconciliation requires exact equality between collected file paths and GitHub aggregate changedFiles. A +/-1 tolerance is forbidden unless a specific documented GitHub semantic exception is proven and recorded for that PR.
The offline --rebuild-zip path must perform no GitHub API calls, no Git fetches, and no evidence reharvest.
The ZIP must be reconstructible solely from committed frozen evidence inputs and must verify against its committed sidecar after deterministic rebuild.
No merge, close, mark-ready, force-push, branch deletion, history rewrite, review mutation, or production/shared-service mutation is authorized.
This packet produces mechanical evidence only. It must not decide portfolio merge order, supersession, semantic compatibility, or final PR disposition.
All UNKNOWN topology facts must remain UNKNOWN and name the missing evidence.
If implementation changes the meaning of portfolio evidence, the final frozen content head requires an independent audit before this repair may claim PASS.
PR Steward is check-only and cannot grant merge authority.

pr.title: feat(portfolio): open PR portfolio bounded delta reharvest
pr.body: Repair PR #1205 in place to add deterministic Git topology, exact changed-file reconciliation, richer pair evidence, S0/S1 drift integrity, and a genuinely offline reproducible evidence-package rebuild. No merge or portfolio disposition authority is claimed.

steps.task: Create a fresh dedicated worktree for the existing PR #1205 branch, establish live repository and GitHub identity, capture current main and PR-head state, and determine drift from the previously reviewed R1 head without treating ordinary drift as a blanket stop.
requirements: Verify repository identity and AGENTS.md marker before mutation.
Fetch current origin/main and existing PR #1205 branch.
Record current origin/main SHA and current PR #1205 head SHA.
If PR #1205 moved from d6c07835f1fc988f2f0b111e4224113d4e789388, inspect the delta and continue when compatible with this packet.
If another actor changed an allowlisted file incompatibly, classify CONFLICTING and stop mutation.
Do not discard or overwrite unrelated work.
validation: Repository identity matches DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp.
Dedicated worktree and branch identity are correct.
Current PR #1205 head and origin/main are recorded.
Any drift from the previously observed R1 head is classified as NO_MATERIAL_EFFECT, AFFECTS_SINGLE_PR, AFFECTS_WORKSTREAM, AFFECTS_GLOBAL_SEQUENCE, or CONFLICTING before implementation proceeds.

steps.task: Remove the +/-1 changed-file reconciliation tolerance and implement a genuinely offline deterministic --rebuild-zip mode using only committed frozen evidence inputs.
requirements: Changed-file reconciliation passes only when collected file count exactly equals GitHub changedFiles.
If an exceptional GitHub counting semantic is encountered, fail closed first; do not add a generic tolerance.
--rebuild-zip must branch before every Git fetch, gh command, GraphQL call, or portfolio recollection.

--rebuild-zip reads existing committed evidence artifacts, validates SHA256SUMS.txt, builds the archive in deterministic file order with normalized archive metadata, computes the sidecar, and verifies the resulting archive.
Two consecutive offline rebuilds from identical inputs must produce the same SHA-256.
A test must monkeypatch or otherwise prohibit run_cmd/network execution during rebuild mode.
validation: python3 -m py_compile scripts/audit/pr_portfolio_delta_reharvest.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/audit/test_pr_portfolio_delta_reharvest.py
Focused test proves a one-file count mismatch is NOT reconciled.
Focused test proves --rebuild-zip executes without Git or GitHub access.
Focused test rebuilds the archive twice from identical frozen inputs and obtains identical SHA-256 values.

steps.task: Add deterministic per-PR Git topology collection against current origin/main and each PR's actual base ref, producing PR_TOPOLOGY.json and PR_TOPOLOGY.csv.
requirements: Fetch every open PR head under an isolated local ref namespace.
Record each PR's baseRefName and resolve whether that base ref corresponds to another currently open PR headRefName.
For each PR compute merge base with origin/main, ahead/behind counts, ancestry direction, head tree, unique commit count, and merge-tree result against current main where supported.
Discover current git merge-tree capability before relying on a particular invocation syntax.
Record whether the PR base is main or another open PR branch.
For a non-main base matching another open PR, record predecessor PR number explicitly.
Do not force current-head ancestry if the predecessor branch moved after successor creation; preserve that as stack/base drift.
Classify only mechanically supported topology states.
validation: Every canonical open PR has exactly one topology record.
Every topology record has a current head SHA and baseRefName.
Every canonical open PR has a merge-base result or an explicit UNKNOWN with missing evidence.
Every canonical open PR has ahead/behind counts or an explicit UNKNOWN.
Every canonical open PR has ancestry classification against origin/main.
Every non-main base is resolved to an open-PR predecessor when possible.
Live PR #1183 baseRefName relationship to #1136 is represented mechanically when still present.
If #1136 current head is not an ancestor of #1183 current head, the record says the stack/base ref moved or diverged rather than falsely reporting clean ancestry.

steps.task: Replace the current SAME_HEAD/SHARED_FILES/INDEPENDENT heuristic with multi-axis mechanical pair evidence and reserve semantic judgment for the later GPT-5.6 Pro synthesis stage.
requirements: Retain all N*(N-1)/2 pair records.
Each pair must contain separate path_relation and ancestry_relation fields.
Use PATH_DISJOINT rather than INDEPENDENT when paths do not intersect.
Record A_IS_ANCESTOR_OF_B, B_IS_ANCESTOR_OF_A, SAME_HEAD, or NO_ANCESTRY_RELATION where mechanically established.
Record base-ref stack links separately from ancestry.
Record tree equality.
For candidate edges only, compute stable patch/delta evidence sufficient to identify obvious identical, subset, superset, or distinct patches when mechanically provable.
Candidate edges include path overlap, explicit stack/base relation, ancestry relation, same tree, or other deterministic similarity discovered by the collector.
Do not label semantic compatibility or conflict from path overlap alone.
Merge-tree conflict evidence may be recorded mechanically but must not be promoted to final portfolio disposition.
validation: EXPECTED_PAIR_RECORDS == ACTUAL_PAIR_RECORDS.
No pair is classified INDEPENDENT solely from path disjointness.
Every pair has path_relation and ancestry_relation.
Every explicit open-PR base-ref relationship is represented in the pair evidence.
Known live stack relation #1136/#1183 is not reduced to SHARED_FILES.
Heavy patch analysis is limited to candidate edges and reports UNKNOWN when evidence is insufficient.

steps.task: Run the repaired collector once against current live state, perform final S1 drift reconciliation, regenerate frozen evidence artifacts, and prove that the package can subsequently be rebuilt offline without recollection.
requirements: Capture S0 origin/main and complete open-PR head map.
Run complete file and topology harvest.
Generate pair evidence.
Capture S1 origin/main and open-PR head map.
If main, PR set, base refs, or relevant heads moved during collection, refresh only affected facts and edges before issuing the final verdict.
The evidence PR itself may remain EXCLUDED_EVIDENCE_PR for portfolio judgment while still being present in collection cardinality; document the distinction.
Regenerate relative SHA256SUMS.txt.
Delete the generated ZIP after first build, reconstruct it using --rebuild-zip with network/Git disabled, and verify the sidecar.
Do not claim PACKAGE_REBUILDABLE merely because the command-line flag exists.

python3 scripts/audit/pr_portfolio_delta_reharvest.py --verify-only

sha256sum -c portfolio_reharvest.zip.sha256 passes in the proof directory after offline rebuild.
